findings.title: Standalone players cannot see quest checkpoints, chai customers or stickers in Eye view — the newly added standalone renderer has none of the marker pass in the served game
findings.observed: The documented standalone Eye view renders no side-quest, chai or sticker markers.

findings.title: Standalone Eye-view drivers miss other vehicles' headlights and wet-road reflections — the added 3D scene renders only unlit vehicle boxes and the player's spotlight
findings.observed: Rainy-night Eye view has no traffic lights or wet-road streaks in the standalone game.

findings.title: Standalone Eye-view drivers have no dashboard, speed gauge or radio controls — the documented game never adds the new dashboard
findings.observed: Driving in Eye view shows no dashboard or dashboard Next song button.

findings.title: Eye-view players see a distorted giant quest giver after vehicles or reflections render — the first giver transform reuses the preceding vehicle or streak scale
findings.observed: The first nearby giver inherits scales such as 2.6 or 200 from a lamp or beam.

findings.title: Standalone drivers can still lose normal campus music for an entire stalled song — the changed standalone radio loop never times out its immediately ducked load
findings.observed: A pending play leaves RADIO.on true and campus music ducked indefinitely.

findings.title: Standalone players still lose a Terrace song after a temporary radio error — the standalone radio marks the shared playlist entry bad
findings.observed: A radio error sets the shared song's bad flag until reload.

findings.title: Drivers lose normal campus music while the next radio song stalls — switching tracks clears playing without restoring the previously ducked music gain
findings.observed: After a playing track changes, a stalled next track leaves campus gain at 15%.

findings.title: Eye-view Lost Teammate players get no cyan target column — the renderer uses UI.sideWp, but neither waypoint producer supplies a lost-quest target
findings.observed: Lost Teammate sets UI.sideWp to null throughout the quest.

findings.title: Players lose a just-collected sticker on reload — collection updates only memory and never writes the saved sticker flags
findings.observed: Reloading immediately after collecting a sticker restores the last saved got flags.

findings.title: Eye-view Yulu riders cannot see gates approached diagonally — the billboard rotation flips the world-y component and turns the ring edge-on
findings.observed: A gate approached on a 45° diagonal is oriented edge-on to the player.

findings.title: Eye-view drivers see no wet-road streaks from their own vehicle — the reflection list excludes S.veh and the driver's spotlight has no streak path
findings.observed: The driven vehicle is excluded from lit, so it produces no wet-road streaks.

findings.title: Portrait phone drivers lose the side-quest counter and timer behind the dashboard — its fixed top position overlays the stacked HUD at a higher z-index
findings.observed: The portrait dashboard starts at 200px and overlays the active side-quest HUD.

findings.title: Phone drivers cannot read the playing song and artist on the dashboard — touch CSS hides the artist and clips the title
findings.observed: On touch screens dashBy is display:none and long track titles are truncated.

findings.title: Drivers repeatedly return to a broken radio after three failed tracks — the retry loop keeps RADIO.want and restarts the cycle instead of staying off
findings.observed: Three failures turn the radio off for 8 seconds, then RADIO.want restarts retries.

findings.title: Screen-reader drivers cannot find the Eye-view speed, song or Next control — the dashboard remains aria-hidden after it is shown
findings.observed: The visible dashboard and Next button remain inside aria-hidden="true".

findings.title: Eye-view Impostor players cannot see the final meeting destination — the 3D marker pass uses points() that never returns Main Hall
findings.observed: After the Impostor tasks and clues, Eye view marks teammates but not the hall.

findings.title: Drivers see the previous Radio on message over silence after skipping — radioSkip removes its toast from the array without rerendering the toast container
findings.observed: After Next, the removed Radio on toast stays in the DOM during a stalled load.

findings.title: Daytime Eye-view players can miss the cyan waypoint against the sky — its 35%-opacity marker has almost no contrast with the declared sky colour
findings.observed: A daytime waypoint column over the sky composites to about 1.08:1 contrast.

findings.title: Drivers and Terrace visitors lose songs after a transient startup load error — the shared metadata preload silently drops failed tracks and the radio retries never reload them
findings.observed: A failed metadata preload leaves the song src null until reload or a manual reload.

findings.title: Crowd Control players still cannot politely clear a sheltering bystander in rain — the changed interaction writes a target that rain movement overrides
findings.observed: A sheltering bystander ignores the E exit target while rain remains active.

findings.title: Players still cannot retry Eye view after a temporary load failure — both render paths suppress fppLoad once FPP.st is -1
findings.observed: Eye view remains in FPP.st=-1 after a temporary load or initialization failure.

findings.title: Eye-view players still cannot reframe photos — the changed 3D render path ignores photo camera offsets
findings.observed: Photo movement changes cam.x/y but the visible Eye camera stays at the player.

findings.title: Players with slow Eye-view rendering wait much longer for stalled radio tracks to skip — the watchdog measures frame time capped at 50 ms rather than elapsed time
findings.observed: At 5 rendered frames/s the 7-second stall limit takes about 28 real seconds.

findings.title: Eye-view drivers cannot take a clean photo without the dashboard — photo mode does not hide the separately mounted dashboard
findings.observed: Photo mode hides the HUD but leaves the dashboard visible over the photo frame.

findings.title: Eye-view Yulu riders see clipped checkpoint rings — the upright rings are centered too low and intersect the ground
findings.observed: A 78-unit gate centered 30 units high has its bottom 48 units below ground.

findings.title: Drivers briefly see the failed song announced after radio failover — the error path never clears its earlier Radio on toast
findings.observed: A failed playing track's Radio on toast remains for up to 2.7 seconds.

findings.title: Drivers still see the floating radio button over photos and pause screens — neither the changed placement nor visibility logic hides it for those modes
findings.observed: Next song remains visible over the pause and photo overlays.
